audit.whatIsWrong: This page was written against the PRE-REWORK Aurelion Sol and is fabricated end to end. It names 'Starsurge' (does not exist — his R is Falling Star, upgrading to The Skies Descend) and 'Voice of Light passive stars' (the passive is Cosmic Creator, which grants Stardust). It says he 'has no dash or blink before level 6' and calls him stationary — Astral Flight is a 22s flight over terrain available from level 2. It says his ultimate 'grants global mobility' and 'global presence' — Falling Star is a 1250-range stun, not a global. It describes him 'orbiting you with stars', which is not in this kit at all. Singularity is never mentioned despite being the ability that decides fights: it pulls, it grants him Stardust for every second you are inside, and its centre executes below a percent-health threshold.
audit.why: Riot text for the current kit: P 'break down enemies into stacks of Stardust'; W 'flies over terrain in a targeted direction'; E 'slowly pulling them toward its center... executes enemies who are below a certain p[ercent]'; R 'Falling Star... stuns enemies... Gathering enough Stardust transforms Aurelion Sol's next Falling Star into The Skies Descend.' The packet also lists 'never names any of Aurelion Sol's abilities' as a defect.

edits.before: Akshan dominates this lane early since Aurelion Sol has no dash or blink before level 6 and his stars need time to charge before his Q does real damage. Poke him relentlessly with Q boomerang and punish him whenever he tries to walk up and orbit you with stars, since your E lets you dodge his Starsurge stun attempts. He's also mana-hungry early, so keep the pressure on to force him into losing farm or flashing away.

He's also mana-hungry early, so keep the pressure on to force him into losing farm or flashing away.

edits.before: By the time Aurelion Sol completes his first real item his stacked stars and burst combo start to outscale your poke damage, letting him one-shot squishies from range with Starsurge into full rotation — this is where the lane balance tips in his favor. With two-plus items his R-enabled global presence and raw magic damage output become a serious teamfight threat that your kit struggles to out-damage directly, so you need to play around picks rather than straight trades.
edits.after: By the time Aurelion Sol completes his first real item, stacked Stardust makes Breath of Light a genuine damage channel and Singularity's centre executes anyone below its percent-health threshold — this is where the lane balance tips in his favor. With two-plus items The Skies Descend drags a whole team into range and stuns, and no amount of armour answers a percent-health execute, so play around picks from a wall you can swing off rather than straight trades.

notes: This matchup was written for the PRE-REWORK Aurelion Sol and was the worst page in my slice: 'Starsurge' and 'Voice of Light' are abilities that do not exist on this champion, he was described as having no dash before 6 (Astral Flight is a level-2 flight over terrain), and his ultimate was called global twice (Falling Star is 1250 range). All of it is replaced with Riot's current kit. Two things I deliberately did not assert: Breath of Light carries a 'channel — interruptible' flag, but Akshan has no CC in his kit, so I made no claim about interrupting it; and whether Astral Flight can carry him over a Heroic Swing arc or knock Akshan off is not answerable from the kit files.
